title: Create purchase receipts from authorized procurement source selection
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Provide bounded read-only procurement candidates and exact source detail lookup under live enabled stock-in and purchase-order permissions plus existing authoritative ownership/customer scope before counts or rows. Show exact approved nondeleted purchase order id/no, supplier, currency, eligible product/spec/base unit and remaining receivable quantity using ERP342 rules. Duplicate ambiguous product rows, missing/unknown units, cancelled/deleted/unapproved and foreign-owned sources are unavailable; no inferred links, arbitrary SQL or new grants.

Add functional source selector to stock-in create/edit: explicitly choose order, fill authoritative supplier and eligible product lines, retain user-selected enabled warehouse, allow positive partial receipt quantity, save/reopen exact PurchaseOrderId. Preserve null historical unlinked receipt semantics. Keep ERP033 cost/rate fallback and ERP342 gross receipt capacity unchanged; candidate selection must not fabricate cost, reopen capacity from returns or post inventory. Actual controller repeats source/quantity validation under existing source locks on approval; stale source/capacity/permission or invalid edit preserves document/stock/ledger and user input. Test real SQL partial/duplicate/foreign/disabled/revoked/cancelled/race and executable JS select/save/reopen with actual browser evidence or accurate blocker.

implementation_evidence: ERP342 enforces PurchaseOrderId fulfillment and ERP344 live inbound authorization, but stock-in form has no purchaseOrderId field or source selector and StockInController has no bounded order-candidate route. Operators cannot establish procurement-to-receipt trace through the business screen.
